r2_body: R.15. v.1. † I ſaid in mine exceſſe : Euerie man is a lyer. In the middes of my great affiidion I profeſſed, that al mans helpe is vaine, falſe, deceipful, and deſeſtiue, aud thei fore our truſt muſt be m Godonly. † What shal I render to our Lord, for al. thinges that he hath rendred to me? Conſidering that God hath not only geuen, and beſtowed manie great benefites vpon me, and al mankind, but alſo hath rendered good for euil, mercie for our ſinnes, we haumg rendered euil for good : whar now ſhal I render, ſayth a true penitent, for al that he hath thus rendered to me, deſeruing ſo euil † I wil take the chalice of ſaluation : and I wil inuocat the name of our Lord. Seing Iam not able to render anie thing worthie of Gods ſauoure to me, yet Iwildo that I can : I wil gratfully accept his great benefite. rhe cuppe of Chriſts paſſion, which he druunke for mankind, h and wil praiſe, and cal vpon his name. † I wil render my vowes to our Lord before al his people : † precious in the ſight of our Lord is the death of his Sainctes. I wil pay voluntarie vowes, k for Gods glorie, and edification of others. Iyea I wil offer my Iife, and ſuffer death, when Gods glorie ſhal require ir, in whoſe ſight, the death of Sainctes is precious, and moſt highly eſteemed. † O Lord becauſe I am thy ſeruant : I am thy ſeruant, and the ſonne of thy hand maide. mAlvwayes vnderſtood, that ſuch as ſuffer perſecution, be in good ſtate of their ſoules, the true ſeruantes of God, the children of the Church his handmaide. Thou haſt broken my bondes : † I wil ſacrifice to thee the Deliuered hoaſt of praiſe, and I wil inuocate the name of our Lord. † I wil render my vowes to our Lord in the ſight of al his people: † in the courtes of the houſe of our Lord, in the middes of thee ô Ieruſalem. PSALME CXVI. me from cap- tiuine of ſinne. In the Church of the faithful. Godi mercie is largely txtended to al Gentiles by Chriſt, aud hit promiſe TheChurchof witha is performed to the Iewves. Alleluia. Chriſt in alna- rions the s. key. PRAYSE our Lord al ye Gentiles: prayſe him al ye I peoples. Nor only ſome, but al nations of the Gentiles : b and al Ievves, (Chriſts Redemption being abundantly ſufficient for all are iuited to praiſe God. † Becauſe his mercie is confirmed vpon vs : and his truth remaineth for euer. Becauſe he hath multiplied his mercie to vs Gentiles, to vvhom he made no promiſe : and moſt truly performed his promiſe made to the Iewve PSALME
